title: RoomCreate
description: POST /api/rooms (contract §4.9): a new room of existing scenes, in this order. The first becomes the origin (pose {0, 0, 0}, pose_source origin), the others unplaced; every scale 1. Nothing is aligned until POST /api/rooms/<room>/align. 400 for a duplicate scene or a bad title, 404 for a scene that doesn't exist, 409 for a scene already in a room.

title.description: Trimmed; at most 200 characters after that (400 otherwise); blank or null means none.
